machine.description: Type of machine to emulate: hercules, cga, tandy, pcjr, ega, vgaonly, svga_s3 (default), svga_et3000, svga_et4000, svga_paradise, vesa_nolfb, vesa_oldvbe

memsize.description: Amount of emulated memory in KB (typically 16384 for DOS applications)

render.frameskip.description: Number of frames to skip to improve rendering performance

render.scaler.description: Graphical scaler to use (e.g., none, normal2x, hq2x, scale2x); see dosbox.conf for full list

cpu.cycles.description: CPU cycle count (negative to slow down, positive to speed up); 'max' can be used for auto-detection

cpu.core.description: CPU core type: auto, normal, simple, full, dynamic, intx86

sblaster.type.description: Sound Blaster type to emulate: sb1, sb2, sbpro1, sbpro2, sb16, none

sblaster.base.description: Base I/O port for Sound Blaster

sblaster.hdma.description: High DMA channel for Sound Blaster (for SB16)

autoexec.lines.description: List of commands to run in [autoexec] section on startup; one per line
